newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse OKs Alpha Credit Bank rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse OKs Alpha Credit Bank rights issue.

text.p: The Athens bourse cleared Alpha Credit Bank's rights issue prospectus.

Following the approval by its shareholders on Thursday, Alpha Credit will issue 6.6 million new registered shares at 11,000 drachmas a share. Rights will entitle shareholders to one new share for every four outstanding.
The bank will also go ahead with a bonus share distribution. It will issue 6.6 million bonus shares -- one bonus for every four outstanding.
Alpha Credit Bank shares gained 1,374 drachmas on Friday to close at 18,557, up 8.0 percent. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
